headline: Zondacrypto Affair and Disappearance of Suszek: Prosecutors Make a Move
summary: Prosecutors have merged the Zondacrypto affair with the disappearance of Sylwester Suszek, head of crypto exchange BitBay, the predecessor of Zonda. Prosecutors cite a subject-matter connection between the cases.
why: Zonda, formerly BitBay, is a Polish crypto exchange. Legal action involving crypto platforms affects customer confidence and regulatory scrutiny of the sector.
